images.caption: Figure 5:Share of tasks in which the injected direction’s own option receives the largest state-minus-text shift in log-probability among the eleven options of the lettered readouts, atρ=1.5\rho=1.5; one in eleven (9%) is the reference for uniform ranking. Columns: model and framing (research check, R2a; first person, R2b). Outlined, bold cells: the share’s pointwise 95% Wilson interval lies above one in eleven and the own option’s mean shift exceeds the mean shift of the other content options, with a 95% bootstrap interval above zero. Each named cell has 120 paired trials; “random” pools two directions over the same 120 tasks (240 trials) and counts as correct when it raises “something else”. Onlyρ=1.5\rho=1.5is shown; AppendixDlists the specific cells at every dose.
